captions.detailed: An anamorphic cinema lens featuring a large matte black cylindrical body with integrated glass elements on both ends. It includes a geared focus ring and a front squeeze housing with a rotating orientation collar. The geared focus ring rotates continuously on its coaxial band, and the orientation collar rotates continuously around the front housing, allowing for precise mechanical adjustments.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a black cine-anamorphic lens with a main cylindrical body, a rotating geared focus ring, and a front squeeze housing with a rotating orientation collar, incorporating continuous joint articulations for both rings.
captions.factory: The code constructs the lens by modeling a main body using nested cylinders and a lens glass element at the tip. It then builds a geared focus ring and an orientation collar using circular patterns of box primitives subtracted from or added to cylindrical bases. Continuous joints are established along the Z-axis to allow independent rotation of the focus ring and the orientation collar relative to the main body.
